title: lattice: implement coverage analyzer
description: Refactor the coverage analysis logic into a pure lattice function. Detect missing components or behaviors based on the intent context.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL identify missing requirement areas.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL return a list of CoverageGaps.

unwanted.condition: IF a required field is not covered by any behavior
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT assign a 100% coverage score

preconditions: Input consists of a list of Behaviors and a list of expected Components
postconditions: Output is a pure data structure representing coverage state
invariants: The analyzer does not perform any I/O

phase_0: Move logic from intent/quality/analyzer.rs to lattice/coverage.rs

title: lattice: implement artifact compaction
description: Implement a pure function to compact multiple requirements and answers into a summarized artifact for the Planning phase.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide summarized context for complex specifications.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL reduce redundant text while preserving semantic meaning.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow the compaction to be used as a source of truth
unwanted.because: compaction is for context, not for definition.

preconditions: Input is a list of Answer objects
postconditions: Output is a single summarized string
invariants: The output size is strictly less than or equal to the input size

title: intent: implement batch requirement processor
description: Implement a batch processor in src/intent/batch.rs to handle bulk requirement updates and large-scale spec refactors efficiently.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL support high-volume requirement operations.

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a batch of changes is submitted
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL process them in a single database transaction.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT leave orphaned work items

preconditions: DiscoverySession is in a writeable state
postconditions: All items in the batch are committed or none are
invariants: The session version is incremented once per batch

title: intent: implement phase completion logic
description: Formalize the logic for marking Discovery and Planning phases as 'Complete' in the project metadata and redb store.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL track the current project phase.

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a phase meets all exit criteria
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL update completed_phases in project_metadata.

unwanted.condition: IF exit criteria are not met
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow the phase to be marked complete

invariants: Phase completion is irreversible without explicit 'reset'
